geometry: White thirty-second-note silhouette with a square stem, two rectangular cutouts and a rectangular notehead, plus a small triplet numeral. The canvas is 16 by 16 pixels; the note occupies x=2..13 and y=0..14, and the numeral occupies x=1..3 and y=1..5. The source uses one-bit transparency: black pixels are transparent.
limitations: The outlined numeral and note retain the source’s geometric shapes. The 8x rendering was inspected.
